children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Niva Bupa Health Insurance

Niva Bupa hosted a conference call to discuss the implications of the consultation paper released on distribution regulations. The company believes that the measures in the draft would be a net positive for the industry and the company. We concur with the view that the measures are positive over the medium term, whereas in the shorter term, the industry will reassess product constructs and distribution architectures, which could weigh on growth.
We maintain our estimates and retain BUY rating with a one-year TP of INR100.
